plan.title: SHG Loan Register: Repayment & Purpose Analysis
plan.subtitle: Overview of loan disbursements, repayment status distribution, and purpose breakdown across SHGs.

panels.title: Total Disbursed Amount (Rs)
panels.sql: SELECT SUM("Loan Amount (Rs)") AS total_amount FROM "shg_loan_register"

panels.title: Loans by Repayment Status
panels.sql: SELECT "Repayment Status", COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM "shg_loan_register" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Disbursed Amount by Loan Purpose
panels.sql: SELECT "Purpose", SUM("Loan Amount (Rs)") AS total_amt FROM "shg_loan_register" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Top Blocks by Number of Overdue Loans
panels.sql: SELECT "Block", COUNT(*) AS overdue_count FROM "shg_loan_register" WHERE "Repayment Status" = 'Overdue' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

plan.narrative:
The SHG loan register contains {{p1}} total loans disbursed, amounting to {{p2}} in total value. The majority of these loans are currently in a 'Regular' or 'Closed' state, with the remaining classified as 'Overdue'. Specifically, the bar chart for repayment status shows that {{p3.cnt}} loans are overdue, indicating potential liquidity challenges for some groups.

Looking at the utilization of funds, the largest share of disbursed capital goes towards {{p4.Purpose}}, followed by other key sectors like Agriculture and Housing. This distribution highlights the primary economic activities supported by these microfinance interventions.
